genius.licensingRegulator: State money transmitter regulators; NMLS ID #2376957. Brale self-describes registered MSB status, not GENIUS authorization.
genius.notes: As of 2026-10-07, Brale Inc. remains the named issuer, consistent with SBC and Glo Dollar sidecars. Mississippi independently lists its money-transmitter license; Brale's homepage self-describes registered MSB status; that registration was not independently verified. Neither establishes PPSI approval or a state-qualified GENIUS route. No token-specific public approval, application or pathway announcement was located in reviewed materials. The general federal regime is still pre-effective. Reserve disclosure and redemption-policy flags indicate public disclosure, not adequacy under GENIUS. Etherfuse describes periodic underlying Stablebond attestations; no current MXNe-specific monthly attestation was verified. The unrelated SBC pilot is not an MXNe authorization.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: As of 2026-10-07, reviewed federal proposals, the OCC applications table, NYDFS directory and Brale disclosures did not identify a public Brale/MXNe GENIUS issuer approval, qualified state status or official application. The application table and indexed searches are not exhaustive evidence that no filing or action exists. State money transmission and disclosed MSB registration do not satisfy GENIUS authorization.

applicabilityBasis.summary: Brale identifies MXNe as a Mexican-peso stablecoin for payments, remittances and payroll, with supported U.S. businesses able to mint and redeem 1:1 with USDC or USDP. This supports apparent payment-stablecoin classification for a non-USD currency. The opened launch page specifies digital-asset redemption rather than a complete enforceable national-currency redemption contract, so this is a product-level apparent classification, not a statutory compliance finding.
